_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Looking up the official export steps...

description: Use this when the user wants to export or download videos they uploaded themselves to TikTok, YouTube, Instagram or X. Pass the platform, for example {"platform": "youtube"}. Returns the official steps in order, their limits and the help_url to quote. It does not sign in or fetch the video. Not for any other platform, such as Douyin, Bilibili or Xiaohongshu: no export steps are offered here, so do not call it; tell the user to use that platform's own account settings. Not for someone else's video or for finding footage (use search_free_videos). We do not rip videos from social platforms or remove watermarks.

platform.description: Where the user uploaded the videos. Example call: {"platform": "youtube"}. Steps exist only for these 4; for any other platform, send the user to its own account settings

name: own_video_export

applies_to.description: Whose videos the steps cover: only the signed-in account holder's own uploads

checked_on.description: Date the help page was last checked (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD)

does_not.description: What this service does not do: no download of other people's videos and no watermark removal

help_title.description: Title of the official help page

help_url.description: Link to the official help page. Give it to the user with the steps

limits.description: Limits the help page states, such as file format or waiting time

steps.description: The official steps, in order, from the platform's help page

title: Export your own videos
